limitations: Predicted structures and confidence values are computational estimates and require scientific interpretation.
The fast model is single-sequence only; use the standard model when supplying an MSA.
An optional A3M conditions the single chain the FASTA must then contain, at the model's released alignment defaults.
Runtime and accelerator memory grow with total token count and with the number of diffusion samples.
Each FASTA record is an independent work item; a record that exhausts its accelerator memory fails alone and the remaining sequences still complete.
